title: Workplace Culture
text: Research and describe what it is like to work in various workplaces, considering uniforms, work culture, and status.
cdi_links: 4.E.05 Researching the range of workplaces and what it is like to work there

title: Introduction
bullets: Workplaces have their own cultures, expectations, and ways of working
Uniforms, workplace culture, and hierarchy affect people’s experiences
Understanding these factors helps you decide what kind of workplace suits you

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can research and describe what it is like to work in different workplaces
I can consider uniforms and dress codes
I can consider status, hierarchy, and responsibility

title: Key Words
bullets: Workplace Culture – Shared values, behaviours, and expectations in a workplace, including communication and attitudes
Hierarchy – Levels of responsibility and authority within a workplace, including managers, supervisors, and team members
Professional Identity – How someone is recognised in their role through behaviour, dress, responsibilities, and position

title: Starter Activity – Thinking About Workplaces
bullets: What makes one workplace different from another?
Why might some people enjoy a strict workplace while others prefer a relaxed one?
Can you think of a job where uniform is important? Why?

title: Complete the Sentence
sentence: Understanding workplace ______ helps you identify a suitable working ______.

title: Key Takeaways
bullets: Workplaces vary in culture, uniforms, and hierarchy
Understanding workplace culture helps you identify a suitable working environment
Researching sectors gives insight into expectations and professional identity
